primary.title: 8th Pay Commission: OPS vs NPS debate gains momentum as employee groups seek guaranteed pension
primary.summary: 8th Pay Commission: The OPS vs NPS debate has emerged as a key issue, with employee and pensioner groups seeking guaranteed retirement benefits, higher pensions and stronger social security provisions for government employees.

related.title: 8th pay commission: Himachal Pradesh, central govt pensioners stage protest, demand uniform pension revision
related.summary: Himachal Pradesh and central government pensioners in Shimla staged a protest on Saturday, demanding withdrawal of the Centre's 2025 pension validation legislation. They are seeking uniform revision of pensions irrespective of the date of retirement.
